subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Which remaining Gateway resilience behaviors should core own after the current-main crash-loop breaker: full watchdog/recovery config, richer health schema, configurable global error strategies, broader degraded startup, or only narrower slices?
rationale: The remaining request changes Gateway recovery semantics, config surface, security posture, and operator expectations, and it overlaps with multiple open partial PRs/issues.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split slices
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, document the crash-loop breaker as partial progress, and promote narrow follow-up work only after maintainers approve each recovery and diagnostics contract.

options.title: Supersede crash-ladder work to #79165
options.body: Use #79165 as the canonical tracker for graduated crash recovery while keeping this issue only for the broader health and error-policy gaps.

options.title: Reject broad configurable recovery
options.body: Document the existing crash-loop breaker and external/plugin watchdog paths, and close broader automatic recovery/global error strategy work as out of core scope for now.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, document the crash-loop breaker as partial progress, and promote narrow follow-up work only after maintainers approve each recovery and diagnostics contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/runtime work makes this the best available owner signal for the product-boundary decision, with obviyus as the crash-loop breaker implementation context.
